Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have from the 2020 Under-19 World Cup. Bangladesh are the champions, India are the the runners-up, Pakistan are third, New Zealand fourth, West Indies 5th, Australia 6th, Afghanistan 7th and South Africa 8th. England are the Plate champions. Thank you very much for tuning in to our coverage. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

As far as India are concerned, they will be ruing enough game time for their middle order. Could they have tweaked their batting order a little bit in any of the games and given their batsmen a bit more exposure? There is always this one dreaded game where your batting order collapses and unfortunately for them, it turned out to be the day of the final. They bowled brilliantly though, not far away from becoming the first ever team to defend its World Cup title - but it was not to be so. Plenty of positives to take from.

Akbar Ali is really happy to move away from Ian Bishop because he can now go and lift the trophy with his mates. Well played, Bangladesh, just about holding their nerves better than India. They win their first ever Under-19 World Cup and also register their 10th successive win in Youth ODIs - a record. What a game to create that record.

Victorious Bangladeshi captain, Akbar Ali, says that winning their maiden Under-19 World Cup is a dream come true, citing the hard work put in the last 18 months. Thanks the coaches and the support staff. On the grand but intimidating occasion of a World Cup final, Akbar says that his guys were very much pumped up for this game but he cautioned them to play normally. Praises the Indian team for having a superb tournament. Once again, thanks his coaches and support staff. Believes that this would be a stepping stone for a very bright future in Bangladesh cricket. Thanks the crowd for its amazing support throughout.
Smiling time! Who else? Bangladeshi lads. They cannot stop smiling. Gleefully accept their medallions.

Indian skipper, Priyam Garg, manages a smile. Admits that the day was not good for them but he is proud of the way his bowlers fought and thanks the Almighty for everything. On India's batting in the final, Garg says that toss played a crucial role as the wicket was very damp and the Bangladeshi bowlers bowled very well. Lauds his openers but believes that the middle order could have done better. Feels that 220 could have been a winning total. On any particularly different tactics while bowling, Priyam says that nothing else could have been done, his bowlers did exceptionally well but Bangladesh batted superbly. Agrees that this was a very good experience not only in this tournament but even in the series before that, in this very same country.

The Indian players are now given their medallions. They look downcast but they can be proud of themselves. It could have so easily been a one-sided game and Bangladesh could have crushed them. But the runners-up made more than a fist of it.

YASHASVI JAISWAL HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE TOURNAMENT. 400 runs across the event, at an average of 133.33 and a strike rate of 82.47. 4 half centuries and 1 century, with 3 not outs in 6 innings. Says that he really enjoyed the tournament and is happy with the experience of playing in South Africa. On playing carefully in this match, Jaiswal says that he just focussed on playing his own game. On his future prospects, Yashasvi says that he is only going to look at the process he follows regularly, in the matches that will come next.

BANGLADESH CAPTAIN, AKBAR ALI, HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. On his batting knock, Akbar says that when he arrived at the crease, Bangladesh needed a partnership and says that the planning was simple (really?). Adds that the batsmen knew it would be a difficult chase right from the start as India would not let any team win so easily. Stresses that he just used the opportunity to spend some time in the middle and take his team home.
The presentation is about to begin. The match officials are given their medallions.
Parvez Hossain Emon is called too. Says that it is a great experience to be called as a champion team. Admits that it was tough for him to bat with all the pain but he is feeling better now.

Coach Richard Stonier now is here for some thoughts. He is extremely happy. Says that he has been looked after well by the staff and management and he is very happy for the young boys - stresses that this moment is theirs. On getting the boys ready for every game, the coach says that he JUST asks his boys to give 150 percent. Thanks his mum and dad and dedicates this moment to them.

Rakibul Hasan is down for a chat. Says that it is a great feeling. They came here to prove themselves and they did. Relishes the experience of doing so. On beating India, Hasan says that they made a plan and executed it.

It was an Avishek Das show earlier in the day as he picked up 3 wickets, while Shoriful Islam and Tanzim Hasan got 2 each. But for India, only Yashasvi Jaiswal stood out, making 88. It was his dismissal which triggered the collapse. Rain did play its part in the match. Bangladesh needed 15 runs from 9 overs when it arrived and when play resumed, the runs needed were revised to 7 from 5 overs.

Heartbreak for India. They batted poorly, losing their last 7 wickets for just 21 runs but their bowlers made more than a match of it. Ravi Bishnoi broke through the middle order, with 4 wickets and then, Sushant Mishra chipped in with 2 wickets. But crucially, for India, Kartik Tyagi and Akash Singh went wicketless while Atharva Ankolekar was not trusted enough, bowling just 4 overs. Did Priyam Garg miss a trick there?

With 76 more needed and just 4 wickets in hand, the match looked gone for Bangladesh. But Parvez Hossain Emon, who has retired hurt on 25, came back on to stitch a 41-run stand with Akbar Ali. India smelled fresh blood once Parvez was dismissed but Rakibul Hossain coming in at number 9 showed excellent composure to stay alongside Akbar and take his team home.

In any normal ODI, this would have been chased down with 8 or 7 wickets to spare and Bangladesh started their chase in fine fashion, rocketing to 50/0. But then, Ravi Bishnoi was introduced and that changed things. The leggie spun a web around the batsmen as the chasing side slipped from 50/0 to 102/6.
Phew. What was that? A nerve-filled humdinger. Bangladesh are the 2020 Under-19 World Cup champions but they made a meal of a simple run chase. Tells us how nerves play a part in a final.

THAT IS THE GAME! BANGLADESH ARE THE 2020 UNDER-19 WORLD CUP CHAMPIONS! Rakibul goes for the glory shot. Hasan comes down the track and swings it over mid-wicket. The ball lands just in front of the fielder in the deep. The batsmen take a single and that will do. VICTORY BY 3 WICKETS!
THE SCORES ARE LEVEL! A length ball, around middle and leg, Hasan dabs it to the leg side, looks at his partner and calls him through!
On a length outside off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! That is through! 2 more to win now. Full and outside off, Rakibul leans and drives it through the covers. The field is in and the ball meets the ropes!
Short and wide outside off, Rakibul has a slash but misses. He immediately says sorry to his partner.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
EDGED AWAY! A length ball, outside off, Akbar looks to fend but the ball rises steeply. The ball takes the top edge but does not carry to third man. A single taken.
We have a revised target. BANGLADESH HAVE A REVISED TARGET OF 170 IN 46 OVERS. They need 7 runs in 30 balls now. Sushant Mishra is back on. 6-0-19-2 so far.

6 pm local (1600 GMT) - Well, one cover is going off! The Bangladeshi batsmen are asked to come back to the dugout from the dressing room. We should have a resumption soon. Sushant Mishra is warming up and getting his rhythm going.

More and more covers are being brought upon. The crowd is waiting anxiously to know the result. This has been one fantastic final between two champion Asian sides. The DLS par score for Bangladesh at the end of 41 overs with 7 wickets down is 147. There is a reserve day on Monday but that will not come into usage now as more than 20 overs have already been bowled in the second innings. Fingers crossed for everyone. Some want the rain to stop. Some want the rain to continue. A real pain for rain. Whom should it listen to? Stay tuned for updates.

Oh dear... the heavens have opened up. It was drizzling since quite a while but it has gotten heavier now. The umpires waited for a couple of overs and have now ushered the players in. There are a few dark clouds but there is plenty of strong breeze as well.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, Rakibul looks to push and run towards cover but then sends Akbar back.
Full and outside off, eased down to long off for a single. The stand moves to 20 from 52 balls.
Tossed up, outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full and straight, Akbar sweeps this dangerously from that line. Finds short fine leg.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Landed outside off, played away from his body to push it towards point.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers. Sweeper runs a good few yards to his right and makes a good diving stop. Two runs added to the total. Akbar moves to 40 from 70 balls.
Plenty of flight, around middle, pushed back defensively.
Around middle, spinning down, tucked towards short fine leg for a quick run. 19 more needed, 64 balls left, just 3 wickets in hand.
Short and outside off, Akbar goes back and pulls it towards wide long on for a single.
Man with the golden arm back on. Yashasvi Jaiswal returns. 2-0-10-1 so far.
Full and outside off, driven to long off for a run.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Risky, very risky. Full and very straight, AA looks to sweep and is lucky that the bat made contact with the ball. Albeit off the leading edge. The ball goes to short mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, Ali looks to cut but misses.
OFF THE INSIDE EDGE! Full and in line of the stumps, Akbar looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge which scoots past the leg stump! Two runs taken by the time fine leg can get across.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Atharva Ankolekar returns. 2-0-17-0 so far.
Very full, outside off, watchfully played towards first slip.
Full and outside off, Hasan presses forward and then pushes this to point. Sets off for a single but then sends Akbar back. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Ali is well in.

FOUR BYES! Oh dear... no one to blame. This is pure bad luck. Full and outside off and it is pitched around the bowler's footmarks from that end. Rakibul lets it go but the ball pitches on that rough and then shoots up well above the keeper, to the fine leg fence! The stand moves to 11 from 36 balls.
A length ball outside off, coming in, tucked through mid-wicket for a single. 150 COMES UP FOR BANGLADESH. 28 more required. 75 balls left. 3 wickets in hand only.
On a length outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, watchfully defended. Tyagi is done for the tournament with the bat and ball. 10-2-33-0 in this final. No wickets but excellent effort.

FIRST RUN FOR AKBAR ALI SINCE THE 31.3. He was on 32 from 41 then. Now, he is 33 from 58. Full and around off, AA drives this straight back. Tyagi gets down to stop but misfields and the ball goes through. Rakibul is busy looking at mid off but his partner calls him through. 29 runs needed, just 3 wickets in hand.

Terrific stop. Full and outside off, Ali drives this through the covers but Yashasvi Jaiswal dives to his left and makes a stunning stop. Bangladeshi dugout is chewing its nails. Given the way this match is going, they might not need dinner.
Back of a length outside off, punched towards cover. Akbar takes a start and Rakibul responds but then the striker sends his partner back.
On a length outside off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Goes for the yorker, ends up bowling a low full toss outside off. Dead-batted.
Another dot. Ali steers this straight to point and this time Rakibul wants the run. Sent back.
Short and outside off, punched towards point. Akbar wants a single but is rightly sent back as Ravi Bishnoi hares across.
On a good length, outside off, RH feels for it and gets a bit of an outside edge. It flies past slip towards third man. A run taken. Off the mark on the 10th ball.
WIDE. Third of the over. Full and miles outside off, Hasan lets it be.
WIDE. Another extra. This is slipped down the leg side, Rakibul looks to flick but misses.
On a length outside off, RH feels for it but misses.
WIDE. A bouncer, bowled way too short, goes well above the head of the batsman. Let through. First run after 23 dots in a row.
Full and wide outside off, Hasan throws his bat at it but misses. There is a noise as the ball goes past but no appeal from the fielding side. Perhaps the bat hit the ground.
A length ball, outside off, Rakibul pushes but misses.
Akash Singh is back on. 6-1-28-0 so far.
THIRD CONSECUTIVE MAIDEN. A length ball, outside off, let through safely.
Back of a length outside off, pretty wide, let through again.
Angled in from wide outside off, coming in, Ali lets it pass.
Full and straight, pushed towards mid on.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
A length ball outside off, Akbar pushes but misses.

Outside off, stays low, punched towards mid off. Bishnoi himself collects and fires a frustrated throw to the keeper. He wanted to finish this off but he has single-handedly got India within three footsteps to the door to victory. 10-3-30-4. Take a bow. Man Of The Final for us. Man Of The Tournament could be Jaiswal.
Full and around off, Rakibul pushes inside the line and gets a thick outside edge. Does not carry to second slip.
Landed outside off, the googly, RH looks to push but misses. The slip cordon is up and appealing but nothing doing from the umpire.
Full and down the leg side, Hasan looks to sweep but misses. The ball goes off his pads but the keeper does well to stop it from going past him.
Plenty of loop, outside off, Rakibul watches it closely and pushes it towards point.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Ravi Bishnoi to bowl again. 9-2-30-4 so far.
On a good length outside off, Ali lets it pass. A MAIDEN FROM TYAGI. The pressure is on.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Landed outside off, this is quietly left alone.
Play and a miss. Short and outside off, Ali flashes hard but misses.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
A short ball, outside off, Akbar looks to cut but is beaten due to extra bounce.
Kartik Tyagi is back on. 7-0-31-0 so far.
Rakibul Hasan walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Too loose from Parvez Hossain Emon and that perhaps is the final blow in this self-stitched coffin by Bangladesh. A part-timer comes on and just like against Pakistan, picks up a wicket. Full and outside off, Parvez cannot resist the temptation. Goes after it, playing a lofted cover drive but cannot clear the fielder. Akash Singh leaps to his left and takes a straight forward catch. Emon stands there, questioning himself as to what has he done. Trudges back and his team comes out near the ropes to pat his back. So near, yet so far. 35 runs needed, just 3 wickets in hand.
Full and outside off, well blocked out.
Tossed up beautifully, outside off, watchfully defended.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, this is driven through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Parvez lunges to defend but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and lands short of first slip.
NEARLY CHOPS IT ON! The googly, outside off, Akbar goes back and looks to punch but is too close to the ball. Gets a bottom edge which just misses the off stump!
Full and outside off, PHE strides and pushes it towards cover. Limps across for a run. He is really struggling. Stretches his legs a little.
The googly, outside off, Emon gets a big stride and lets it pass.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Nicely done. 38 more needed from 118 balls. Around off, Parvez lunges and dabs it past short third man for a boundary!
Full and around off, watchfully pushed towards point.

EDGED, FOUR! Why isn't there a slip in place? Short and outside off, Akbar looks to cut but the ball spins away and takes the outside edge. The ball flies through the vacant slip region to the third man fence!
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and wide outside off, Parvez leans and drives it towards long off for a single.
Short and outside off, Emon initially looks to slog but then adjusts well to defend.

OVERTHROW. Parvez tucks this through square leg and takes a single. The fielder has a needless shy at the bowler's end and the bowler lets it through. Mid off cannot back it up and it is an extra run towards long of.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single. 49 more needed from 125 balls.
Here comes the man with the golden arm. Yashasvi Jaiswal into the attack.
Another big shout for a caught behind. The umpire asks the Indians to calm down. Full and outside off, Parvez pushes but misses again.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Another googly, Parvez pushes but misses again.
Third wrong 'un, PHE pushes but misses again. There is a massive appeal for a caught behind but it is turned down.
Another play and a miss as Parvez pushes but cannot connect.
The googly, outside off, Emon lunges to defend but misses.
The strike bowler is back. Ravi Bishnoi returns. 7-1-25-4 so far.
On a length, around off, defended watchfully.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

MIX-UP, but safe. Parvez Hossain Emon is struggling. He popped up a couple of tablets before this over. Parvez pushes it towards cover and sets off for a single. Then, he stops. But the non-striker is confident about the single and calls him through. There could have been a run out opportunity but Yashasvi Jaiswal charging to his right from cover chooses the striker's end. Misses but Akbar Ali was well in. He could have taken a second and chosen the bowler's end instead.
Landed outside off, left alone.
WIDE. That is a harsh call. Emon walks down the track and has a wild swish at a ball which just grazes the wide guideline. Misses and it is wided.
A length ball, around middle, defended watchfully.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly but straight to mid off.
Full and wide outside off, Parvez throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge towards third man. A run taken. 13 from the over, bit of a breather for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Terrific shot. A length ball, outside off, Emon punches this wide of mid off and gets a boundary!
A bouncer, around middle, PHE ducks.
WIDE. Short and wide outside off, Parvez throws his bat at it but misses.

FOUR! That is a nice shot. On a length outside off, Emon punches this on the up through the covers. Atharva Ankolekar starts to chase but then stops suddenly. He then resumes running and puts in a futile dive, only to see the ball race past. 58 more needed from 141 balls.
WIDE. Well down the leg side, let through this time.
Down the leg side, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Akash Singh is back on. 5-1-15-0 so far.
Landed outside off, Akbar lets it through.

EDGED, JUST WIDE! A length ball, outside off, Ali looks to poke at it. But the ball seams away, takes the outside edge and flies past a diving first slip towards third man. Siddhesh Veer puts in good running strides to his left and slides to stop the ball. Two runs taken.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
On a length, outside off, placed behind point for a single.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Kartik Tyagi returns. 5-0-26-0 so far.

DRINKS BREAK. Phenomenal comeback from India. They were looking down and out when Bangladesh were 50/0 but have roared into this contest. It is they who have tilted the balance and with 68 to get, just 4 wickets remaining, have to favour the fielding side. Bangladesh are responsible for their poor show, going well at one stage and then needlessly throwing it away. Bishnoi started the wreckage but the others are having their fill now.
Full and straight, this is watchfully pushed towards mid on.
Lucky to get away with that. A wild bouncer, around off, Ali lets that sail over. No wide called though.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.

ANOTHER WIDE. This is slipped down the leg side, Akbar misses his tuck. The bowler appeals for the catch but the keeper does not. However, the latter is surprised on the wide call. Did that hit something?
WIDE. Short and well outside off, left alone. 69 more needed from 152 balls.
Outside off, this is played straight to point.
Full and down the leg side, Emon looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg and a leg bye is taken.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
FOUR! Risky shot. Full and in line of the stumps, Akbar gets down and sweeps it to the right of short fine leg!
Around off, punched off the back foot.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers where the fielder dives to his right and makes a terrific stop.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Ankolekar comes on as well.
Parvez Hossain Emon walks back to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! We will not learn from our mistakes. After being dropped twice in 3 balls, Avishek again goes for an attacking stroke. It is a short ball and looks to pull but gets a top edge. Kartik Tyagi gets across from square leg to his right and pouches it safely. India firm favourites to defend their title now.

DROPPED! Easy chance this time. A length ball, outside off, Das looks to guide it to third man but ends up hitting it straight to first slip. Tilak Varma over there looks to take it inches above the ground but fumbles. Tries to take it in the second attempt but cannot.

FOUR! Gets it through! 76 more needed from 164 balls now. Short and outside off, Das gets on top of the bounce and punches it through the covers,. Ravi Bishnoi at point dives to his right but cannot quite stop it.
DROPPED! Bishnoi drops a tough chance. Short and outside off, Das cuts it towards point. Ravi Bishnoi there dives forward but cannot quite grasp the chance.
A length ball, down the leg side, tucked through square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Huge shout for LBW, turned down! Boy, that was close. The googly, around middle, Das looked to defend but missed and was hit on the pads. Was that sliding down leg?
Around off, defended watchfully.
Full and outside off, this is driven through the covers for a run.
FOUR! Cut away! Back-to-back boundaries for Bangladesh. Bishnoi drops it short and Akbar picks the length in a trice. Goes back and cuts it behind backward point.
FOUR! AWESOME! Full and outside off, Akbar leans and drives this through the covers.

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD DAS! Close call. Das taps it to the leg side and sets off for a quick single. Bishnoi quickly gets across and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Avishek was gone for all money!
Ravi Bishnoi is back on. 6-1-15-4 so far.
One more leave outside off to end the over.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full and outside off, close to the wide guideline, left alone again.
WIDE. A slower ball, gone awry, well outside off, let through again.
WIDE. A wild bouncer, well above his head, Ali lets it through.
On a good length outside off, let through to the keeper.
A length ball, outside off, let through.
Avishek Das walks out.

OUT! Caught! India are bowling themselves back into the game while Bangladesh are pushing themselves out of it. Short and wide outside off, Shamim leaps and plays the upper cut. But it is towards sweeper cover where Yashasvi Jaiswal comes charging in and takes a decent catch! The Indians are pumped up. Memories of the 2019 Asia Cup final flooding in...
Sushant Mishra returns. 3-0-14-0 so far.
SIX! POUNDED! That has come out of nowhere. Full and outside off, Akbar gets down and mows a slog sweep over mid-wicket for half a dozen! 12 from the over.
Full and around off, well defended.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for Bangladesh. Full and outside leg, Akbar looks to paddle but misses. The keeper is blinded and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot for a single towards cover.
Atharva Ankolekar is now on.
Short and wide outside off, cut through the covers for a run.
The googly again, outside off, Shamim looks to cut but misses.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket where a misfield allows a single.
On the shorter side outside off, Shamim goes after it. He ends up mistiming it towards point. The fielder slides to his left but fumbles and a single is taken.
Outside off, it is left alone.
A little too straight! This is flicked wide of the fielder at deep mid-wicket for two.
Tyagi is bowling a few wayward deliveries here. This is way too short and outside off, Shamim looks to cut but misses.
Changes the angle and bowls a wide! Comes from around the wicket and bowls this down the leg side. It has been wided.
Slapped but for no runs! Shorter in length and around off, this is slapped hard but straight to covers.
Missing leg! Fuller and on the pads, Shamim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
A single to end! Loopy ball on off, it is driven towards cover for one.
Loopy ball and on middle, Shamim prods forward and is solid in defense.
On middle, it is kept out nicely.
Shorter and way too far outside off, Shamim goes after it but misses. Not wided.
Loopy ball on middle, Shamim defends it onto the ground.
Shamim Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! Brilliant from Jurel. That is why he had his finger up. Hossain's foot was on the line. India are right on top at the moment as Bishnoi gets his 4th. They are into the lower middle order of the Bangladesh side which has hardly been tested. It is a googly, it lands outside off and then turns back in. SH looks to defend with a long stride. It hits the inside edge, then the pads and rolls towards the keeper who takes it with one hand and whips the bails off in a flash. He is appealing and celebrating at the same time. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that the batter has not got his foot back in time.
Do India have another? The Indians are celebrating. Jurel has his finger up and starts celebrating with his teammates. The umpire has taken it upstairs.
Another one which is fuller on middle, Ali pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Ali pushes it to the cover fielder.
On a length outside off, Akbar leaves the ball to go to the keeper.
Singh bowls a full one on middle and leg, Hossain pushes it towards the mid on region for a single.
Fullish delivery outside the off stump line, Hossain leaves the ball alone.
Good length ball on off, Shahadat defends it to the point region.
A couple to end another top over by RB! This is full and outside off, it is driven square on the off side for two.
Close call! It is one more googly, it is a little too straight. Ali looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. Going down leg.
One more googly on off, it turns back in. Ali looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

The Indians are a little too excited out there! Another huge appeal. It is one more googly. It turns back in from middle. Ali looks to put bat on ball but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Saxena at silly point makes a huge appeal but it is turned down. The umpire then has a word with him and asks him to cool down a little.
On off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Akbar Ali, the Bangladesh skipper is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Ravi Bishnoi, take a bow! He has probably got Bangladesh's best batter. Bangladesh's dressing room is stunned at the moment. The leggie has single-handedly got his team right back into the contest. It is once again the googly, the length does Hridoy in though. It is fuller. Hridoy goes back to play at it. The ball skids through, beats the bat and hits the pad. An appeal and up goes the finger. 116 needed with 7 wickets in hand.
Close! This is on a length and around middle, Hossain looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. End of a testing over from Singh.
Good fielding! Indians have their tails up there. On the pads, it is worked towards square leg where the fielder dives to his right and stops it.

That is a peach of a delivery! How did that miss the off pole? A perfect left-arm seamer delivery. WOW! It is full, it starts outside off and then tails back in. Goes between the gap of bat and pad as Hossain looks to drive. It just about brushes the off pole.
Just outside off, not played at. Good bowling this. The pacers need to continue to keep it tight if they aren't getting the wickets.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Hridoy comes down the track and this is bowled on the pads. He tries to flick but it kisses the pads and goes into the hands of the keeper. A huge shout but not given.
Akash Singh is back on! 3-0-14-0 are his figures so far.
Floats it up outside off, Hridoy leaves it alone. Another successful over for the Indians.

There is a slight halt in play and Parvez Hossain Emon seems to be suffering from a hamstring problem. The physio is out to have a look at him. This is not looking good as Emon is making his way back to the pavilion. Could be really painful. Will this be the turning point in this game? Shahadat Hossain replaces him out in the middle.
Towhid Hridoy is the new man in.

OUT! KABOOM! Timber! Drags his length back and gets the reward. The googly does the trick again. Mahmudul does not pick it at all. It is slightly short and outside off. Turns back in. Mahmudul looks to cut but that shot is not on, it is too close to execute it. He misses and the middle stump is uprooted. The Indians are pumped and Ravi Bishnoi is getting India back into the game. 116 more needed.
Very full and on middle, it is hit to covers. Bishnoi is bowling a little too full. He needs to drag his length back a little.
Good stop! Floated up on off, it is driven through extra cover. Tyagi runs to his right, dives and saves three for his side.
Nice shot! This is floated up on middle, it is driven down the ground past mid off. Tyagi at long on runs to his right, slides and keeps it down to two.
On off, blocked.
Another full toss, this time he gets away with it as it is pushed to mid off.
Outside off, it is left alone.

FOUR! Full toss and put away! A loose shot that but it was in the gap. It is outside off, Mahmudul goes after it away from his body. It goes uppishly but well wide of the point fielder and into the fence.
Comes around the wicket and angles this into the batter. Mahmudul stays back and keeps it out nicely.
A bumper now and on middle, it is ducked under.
Shorter and around off, Mahmudul looks to push it on the off side but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Sushant Mishra is back into the attack. 2-0-6-0 are his figures so far.
A dot to end a good over by Bishnoi. Quicker and around off, Hossain pushes it towards cover where the fielder dives to his left and makes a half stop. No run taken.

Another appeal, this time from quite a few Indians but turned down again. Shorter and quicker around off. Emon looks to slap it again but misses. The man running in from mid on feels that there is an edge but the umpire is unmoved.
An appeal from the keeper bt he is the only one doing so! It is the googly around off, shorter and it turns away. Emon looks to cut but is beaten.
Floats it up on off, defended.
Very full and on middle, it is jammed out towards mid-wicket.
Very full and on middle, it is driven to mid off.
On the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket. Bangladesh are 55/1 after  Powerplay 1. A good one for Bangladesh. They need 123 from 40 overs. India were 23/1 at the same stage.

FOUR! Lovely shot to get off the mark! That should give him a lot of confidence. It is not very full, it is behind a driving length around off. Mahmudul strokes it on the up through covers for a boundary.
The physio is out to have a look! The batter is getting some treatment. He seems fine now and all set to continue.
A little too straight, Mahmudul looks to flick but misses to get hit high on his pads. He is actually hit near the box and is in some pain now.
A single now! This is on the pads, it is worked through square leg.
That is a brute of a delivery! Shorter in length and around off, it keeps on rising. Emon looks to defend but the ball whizzes past the glove.
Angled into the off pole. Emon gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
An appeal for LBW turned down. A wrong'un around off, Joy looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Mahmudul Hasan Joy is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ravi Bishnoi has the last laugh! After a good opening stand, Tanzid Hasan has to go. A wrong'un around off, Hasan looks to slog sweep. The ball takes the top edge and goes towards long on. Kartik Tyagi settles himself under it and takes the catch. India needed that wicket to make a comeback in this game.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
BEATEN! Flatter one outside off, Hasan looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
SIX! What a way to bring up the 50-run stand! Flighted ball on middle, Hasan bends on his knees and sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Floated ball on middle, Hasan defends it out.
Spin time! Ravi Bishnoi is into the attack.
FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Full and wide outside off. Hossain Emon throws his bat at it and it flies past cover-point for a boundary.
Another outswinger but the line is outside off. It is left alone.
Good bowling again! This is on off, it shapes away after pitching. Hossain Emon does well to pull his hands out of the way after seeing it move away.
Another jaffa! Full and around middle, swinging away, TH looks to flick but the late swing takes the leading edge. Goes behind point, aerially, towards third man. A single taken.
That is a jaffa. On a length outside off, Hasan looks to defend but the ball lands and then shapes away, to beat the outside edge.
Full and wide outside off, Tanzid throws his bat at it but misses. Not given a wide. That was very close to the wide guidelines.
Good length ball outside off, Hossain Emon leaves the ball alone.
FOUR! Glorious! That sounded sweet! Fullish delivery outside off, Hossain Emon lunges forward and creams the drive through the cover region for a boundary.
On a length on off, Hossain Emon defends it to the point region.
Fullish delivery on off, Tanzid pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.
BEATEN! Wonderful bowling from Tyagi! He bowls one on a length around off, Hasan looks to defend but fails to make any connection to it.
Good length ball on off, Hasan pushes it to the point fielder.
WIDE! Tyagi bowls this one down the leg side, Tanzid leaves the ball alone. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Full delivery outside off, Hossain Emon shoulders arms to this one.
Parvez Hossain Emon has asked for a new bat. He broke his previous one after hitting that boundary of the previous ball.
FOUR! Whipped away! Full on the pads, Hossain Emon whips it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. The fielder gives it a chase but fails to clean it up.
Very full delivery on off, Parvez pushes it to mid off for nothing. The fielder throws it to the bowler's end and hits but Hasan was in.
Full delivery on middle, nipping in. Hossain Emon looks to flick but it takes the inside half of the bat and goes towards mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Parvez defends it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Good start from Singh! Good length delivery outside off, Hossain Emon looks to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge of the bat and goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Akash Singh is into the attack.
Fullish delivery on middle, Hossain Emon flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Short delivery around the pads, Hossain Emon looks to flick but it hits him on the gloves and the ball rolls to square leg.
OUCH! Short delivery around middle, Hossain Emon looks to defend but the ball hits the gloves and rolls onto the pitch.
Fullish delivery on off, Hossain Emon drives it to mid on.
Very full delivery, almost a yorker. Hossain Emon digs it out.
Good length ball on the pads, Hasan flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Hossain Emon shoulders arms to this one.
The physio is out to have a look! Hasan seems to be fine though.
OUCH! Nasty! Short delivery around middle, Hasan looks to pull but gets hit on the helmet. The ball goes to third man and the batters take a leg bye.
Nothing from the Free Hit. Short ball outside off, Hasan looks to pull but fails to get any bat on it.
Free Hit again!

NO BALL AND 4 BYES! What are you doing Sushant Mishra? A beamer around off. Hasan lets it go. Jurel fails to collect it cleanly and the ball goes to the fine leg region for four byes. 5 runs added to the total.
Short ball on middle, Tanzid looks to pull but it takes the bottom edge and goes towards cover. No run.
Length ball on the pads, Hossain Emon looks to flick but it hits the thigh pad and the ball rolls to square leg. A leg bye taken.
Good length ball outside off, Hossain Emon shoulders arms to this one.
An appeal for LBW! Turned down. A low full toss on the pads, Hasan looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Tyagi puts in a huge appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested.
Good length ball outside off, Hasan leaves the ball alone.
In the air...but safe! Short ball around off, Hossain Emon looks to sway away but the ball hits the top edge and lobs off towards fine leg. Hossain Emon is very lucky there. A single taken.
LEG BYE! Length ball on the pads, Tanzid looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to fine leg and the batters steal a single.
On a length on off, Hasan blocks it to the off side.
On a length on off, Tanzid defends it to the cover region.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! There is no need to run for that one. Full outside off, Hossain Emon creams the drive through the cover region for a boundary.
Length ball on middle, Parvez defends it out to mid on.
Missed out on the Free Hit! Fullish outside of, Hossain Emon looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Free Hit time!
NO BALL! A beamer from Mishra. He bowls it around middle, Hossain Emon sways away. A Free Hit will follow.
Good length ball outside off, Hossain Emon shoulders arms to this one.
One more short one and on the body this time. The batter ducks under it.
Starts off with a short one and way outside off. The batter lets it go.
Sushant Mishra will bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Excellent batting from Hasan! This is a terrific start for Bangladesh. Full delivery on the pads, Hasan flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. 13 runs from the first over of Tyagi.

Good length ball on middle, Hasan looks to flick but it seems that it has gone off the leading edge towards the point region. The players appeal for LBW but wonder what they are appealing for. The replays show that it has gone off the bat.
Another full which is outside off, Hasan drives but this time it is straight to the cover fielder.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark. Tyagi dishes a full one outside off, Hasan lunges and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Nicely played! Fullish on middle, Hossain Emon flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region and picks up three before the fielder chases after it and cleans it up.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Hossain Emon looks to flick but misses. Tyagi appeals for a caught behind but the umpire signals it a wide. The replays show that the bat was hitting the pad.
Short of a length ball outside off, Parvez sways away from it.

WIDE! Well kept! Tyagi starts with a very full delivery down the leg side. Hossain Emon lets it go to the keeper. The keeper dives and makes a good stop. Wide signaled. Bangladesh are underway with an extra.

The run chase is all set to begin! The Indian players are in a huddle before making their way out to the ground. Parvez Hossain Emon and Tanzid Hasan are out in the middle in the pursuit of 178. Kartik Tyagi will start for India.
